Win Method Bonuses
\n\n
\n
\n
\u81ea\u6478 Zimo \u2014 Self DrawDrawing your own winning tile from the wall
\n +1 Fan\n
\n
All three losers pay you. Each pays full amount.
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\u9580\u6e05 Concealed GateWinning by discard with a fully concealed hand
\n +1 Fan\n
\n
No tiles declared (no called chow/pung). Last tile is from someone's discard.
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\u5dba\u4e0a\u958b\u82b1 Dead Wall DrawDrawing the winning tile from the supplement wall after a kong
\n +1 Fan\n
\n
After declaring a kong, the extra draw completes your hand.
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\u6d77\u5e95\u6488\u6708 Last TileWinning on the very last drawable tile in the wall
\n +1 Fan\n
\n
The final tile from the wall (\u6d77\u5e95\u724c) completes your hand.
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\u6436\u69d3 Robbing the KongDeclaring a win by stealing an opponent's added kong tile
\n +1 Fan\n
\n
When an opponent adds a 4th tile to an existing pung, you can steal it to win if it completes your hand.
\n
\n\n

\ud83c\udfb2 Table Setup & Dealing
\n
\n
\n A standard set has 144 tiles (136 + 8 bonus flowers/seasons). Players sit at the four compass winds \u2014 East, South, West, North.

\n Each player builds a section of the wall: 18 stacks of 2 tiles high (36 tiles each side), forming a square. One player rolls dice to determine East (\u838a\u5bb6) and the break point in the wall.

\n Dealing: East draws 14 tiles; South, West, North each draw 13. East discards first to begin the game.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83e\uddf1 Wall & Dead Wall
\n
\n
\n The wall has two sections:

\n Live Wall \u2014 tiles drawn during normal play, proceeding counter-clockwise from the break point.

\n Dead Wall (Kong Box) \u2014 the last 14 tiles of the wall, set aside and used only as replacement draws after a Kong or for bonus tile replacements. These tiles are never drawn in normal play.\n
\n
\n\n
\u21a9\ufe0f Turn Order & Play
\n
\n
\n Play proceeds counter-clockwise (East \u2192 North \u2192 West \u2192 South \u2192 East\u2026).

\n On your turn: draw one tile from the live wall, then discard one tile face-up to the center.

\n Bonus tiles (flowers \u82b1, seasons \u5b63) are not kept \u2014 reveal them immediately and draw a replacement tile from the dead wall before discarding.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udce2 Calling Priority
\n
\n
\n When a tile is discarded, players may claim it. Priority order:

\n 1. Win (\u548c/\u80e1) \u2014 any player may claim to win; highest priority.
\n 2. Pung (\u78b0) or Kong (\u69d3) \u2014 any player may claim to form a triplet or quad.
\n 3. Chow (\u4e0a) \u2014 only the player to the discarder's left may claim to form a sequence.

\n A higher-priority claim always beats a lower one. If two players want the same tile for equal-priority claims, the player closer in turn order wins.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udfa3 Fishing (Tenpai)
\n
\n
\n Fishing (\u91e3\u9b5a / Tenpai) means your hand is one tile away from a winning hand.

\n You may be waiting on multiple different tiles simultaneously. Any tile that completes your hand \u2014 whether drawn from the wall (Zimo \u81ea\u6478) or discarded by another player \u2014 allows you to declare a win.

\n There is no formal \"declare fishing\" step in standard HK rules \u2014 you simply win when the tile arrives.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udc80 Dead Hand & Goulash
\n
\n
\n Dead Hand (\u8352\u724c): If the live wall is exhausted with no winner, the round ends in a draw. No points are exchanged. The dealer (East) remains East and a new round begins.

\n Goulash (\u6df7\u4e82\u5c40): A special re-deal rule sometimes played after a dead hand. In Goulash, Chows are forbidden \u2014 only Pungs, Kongs, and pairs are allowed. All tiles are reshuffled and redealt. Rules vary by house \u2014 confirm before play.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udfaf Objective
\n
\n
\n Be the first player to form a complete winning hand of 14 tiles (4 sets + 1 pair, or a special hand). Each win scores points from the other players based on the value of your hand in fan (\u756a). Only the tightest applicable rule counts \u2014 no double-counting overlapping conditions.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udccf Tile Sets
\n
\n
\n Chow \u9806\u5b50 \u2014 3 consecutive tiles of the same suit. e.g. 3-4-5 Bamboo. Only non-honor tiles.
\n Pung \u523b\u5b50 \u2014 3 identical tiles. e.g. three \u767c Green Dragons.
\n Kong \u69d3\u5b50 \u2014 4 identical tiles. Counts as a Pung + draws a replacement tile from the back of the wall. Each kong adds +1 fan.
\n Pair \u5c0d\u5b50 \u2014 2 identical tiles. Every winning hand needs exactly 1 pair (the \"eye\").\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udfc6 How to Win
\n
\n
\n Zimo \u81ea\u6478 (Self-draw) \u2014 You draw the winning tile yourself from the wall. All 3 opponents each pay the full fan value. +1 fan bonus.

\n Discard Win \u51fa\u9283 \u2014 You win off a tile someone else discarded. Only the discarder pays (covering all 3 losers' share in one payment).

\n Minimum fan: A hand must reach the table's minimum fan (usually 3) to be a valid win. A 0-fan hand is called a Chicken Hand (\u96de\u7cca) and is not accepted.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udcb0 Payment Calculation
\n
\n
\n Each table has a stake (e.g. $0.25 per fan) and a minimum fan to win.

\n Zimo: Each of the 3 losers pays = fan \u00d7 stake
\n Discard: Discarder pays = fan \u00d7 stake \u00d7 3

\n Example: 5 fan hand, $0.25 stake \u2192 Zimo: each pays $1.25 (total $3.75). Discard: discarder pays $3.75.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udc00 East Wind Double Rule
\n
\n
\n East (\u838a\u5bb6) always pays and receives double:

\n East WINS: All 3 losers each pay double the normal amount.
\n East LOSES (Zimo): East pays double; other losers pay the normal amount.
\n East DISCARDS: East pays double the full discard penalty.
\n East wins by Discard: The discarder pays double the full amount to East.

\n This applies every round regardless of who the current East player is \u2014 the seat rotates after each East loss.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83e\udded Winds & Seat Rotation
\n
\n
\n Each player holds a seat wind \u2014 East (\u6771), South (\u5357), West (\u897f), North (\u5317). East is the dealer.

\n East wins \u2192 East keeps their seat, everyone stays put.
\n East loses \u2192 All players rotate one seat clockwise (new East player).

\n After all 4 players have held East, the prevailing round wind advances: East Round \u2192 South Round \u2192 West Round \u2192 North Round.

\n Seat wind pung +1 fan \u2014 having a pung/kong of your own seat wind.
\n Round wind pung +1 fan \u2014 having a pung/kong of the prevailing wind.
\n Double wind +2 fan \u2014 if your seat wind equals the prevailing wind (e.g. East player in East Round), a pung of that wind scores +2 fan instead of +1.\n
\n
\n\n
\u69d3 Kong Rules
\n
\n
\n Concealed Kong \u6697\u69d3 \u2014 Draw all 4 of the same tile yourself. Declare it face-down, draw a replacement tile. +1 fan.

\n Melded Kong \u660e\u69d3 \u2014 Add a drawn 4th tile to an existing exposed pung. Draw a replacement tile. +1 fan.

\n Robbing a Kong \u6436\u69d3 \u2014 If you can win using the tile someone adds to their pung (to upgrade it to a kong), you may steal it immediately to win. +1 fan.

\n Win by Kong \u6a43\u4e0a\u82b1 \u2014 If you win on the replacement tile drawn after declaring a kong. +2 fan.

\n Double Kong \u6a43\u4e0a\u6a43 \u2014 Win on the replacement tile of a replacement tile (two consecutive kongs). +9 fan.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83c\udf38 Bonus Tiles
\n
\n
\n Flowers (\u82b1) and Seasons (\u5b63) are bonus tiles \u2014 when drawn, set them aside and draw a replacement immediately. They do not form part of the 14-tile hand.

\n Each bonus tile: +1 fan
\n Own wind flower: +1 fan \u2014 the flower matching your seat wind (e.g. East player gets the East flower).
\n Own wind season: +1 fan \u2014 the season matching your seat wind.
\n All 4 flowers: +2 fan \u2014 collecting the complete flower set.
\n All 4 seasons: +2 fan \u2014 collecting the complete season set.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udd12 Concealed Hand (\u9580\u6e05)
\n
\n
\n A hand is concealed if no sets were called from other players' discards. Earns +1 fan (\u9580\u6e05).

\n Calling a Chow or Pung from a discard breaks concealment. Declaring a kong from your own drawn tiles does not break concealment.\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udeab Common Restrictions
\n
\n
\n \u2022 Must meet the table's minimum fan (usually 3) to declare a win.
\n \u2022 False win \u8a50\u7cca \u2014 declaring an invalid win; typically penalized by paying all players a fixed amount.
\n \u2022 Chombo \u2014 serious rule violation (illegal kong, wrong discard after win, etc.). Penalty set by house rules.
\n \u2022 You cannot win off your own discard.
\n \u2022 Last tile rule: Winning on the very last tile from the wall earns +1 fan (\u6d77\u5e95\u6488\u6708 Fishing the Moon).\n
\n
\n\n
\ud83d\udccb Quick Fan Reference
\n
\n
\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
+1 fanZimo, Concealed Hand, Last Tile, Robbing Kong, each Dragon Pung, Seat Wind Pung, Round Wind Pung, each Kong, each Bonus Tile, Own Flower, Own Season
+2 fanWin by Kong (\u6a43\u4e0a\u82b1), Double Wind Pung (seat = round wind), All 4 Flowers, All 4 Seasons
+6 fanSmall Four Winds (\u5c0f\u56db\u559c)
+3 fanAll Triplets (\u78b0\u78b0\u7cca), Mixed One Suit (\u6df7\u4e00\u8272)
+4 fanSeven Pairs (\u4e03\u5c0d\u5b50)
+5 fanSmall Three Dragons (\u5c0f\u4e09\u5143)
+7 fanPure Suit (\u6e05\u4e00\u8272)
+8 fanBig Three Dragons (\u5927\u4e09\u5143)
+9 fanDouble Kong (\u6a43\u4e0a\u6a43)
+10 fanTerminals & Honors (\u6df7\u4e48\u4e5d), All Honors (\u5b57\u4e00\u8272), Nine Gates (\u4e5d\u84ee\u5bf6\u71c8), All Green / Blue / Red
+13 fanBig Four Winds (\u5927\u56db\u559c), Thirteen Orphans (\u5341\u4e09\u5e7a), Heavenly Hand (\u5929\u7cca), Earthly Hand (\u5730\u7cca), Eighteen Arhats (\u5341\u516b\u7f85\u6f22)
\n
Source: Hong Kong Mahjong scoring rules (Wikipedia)
